info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Mortgage Application Submission API
info.description: The Mortgage Application Submission API enables financial institutions to facilitate the creation and submission of mortgage applications on behalf of customers. This endpoint allows users to input key application details and submit them for processing. Typical consumers include mortgage brokers, loan officers, and other financial service providers looking to streamline their application processes. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance customer experience and improve operational efficiency in handling mortgage requests.

post.summary: Submit a new mortgage application for a specific customer.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a new mortgage application for the customer identified by the specified customer ID. Ensure all necessary information is provided in the request body to successfully process the application.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new mortgage application for the specified customer (CUST-100045). The body must contain all required data fields necessary for processing the mortgage application.

201.description: Mortgage application submitted successfully, and the resource has been created.
